newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian marines destroy 12 drug laboratories.
newsitem.headline: Colombian marines destroy 12 drug laboratories.

text.p: Colombian marines destroyed 12 clandestine drug laboratories in the jungles of southern Putumayo province, navy sources said on Monday.

The navy, responsible for law enforcement along Colombia's vast network of natural waterways, said it seized more than one tonne of coca leaves, the raw material for cocaine production, and more than 500 gallons (1,893 litres) of liquid coca paste, a semi-processed form of cocaine, in operations over the weekend.

Putumayo is one of the main cocaine-producing areas of Colombia. The military says most production and trafficking in the area is controlled by the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's oldest and largest guerrilla army.
